RecordUnavailable.description:
Why Record would be refused for now although the person may record: a hint a client
may show on a greyed Record. It never changes `can_record`.

oneOf.description: The install runs as many recordings as it allows.

description:
A person's Record and Stop in the room they are in, as Sew would take them now
(`Recording.my_controls`, the call socket's READY). Of two values, the larger `rev` is the
newer.

can_record.description: Sew would take this person's Record now (passing conditions aside).

can_stop.description: Sew would take this person's Stop now.

record_unavailable.description: While the person may record: why a start would be refused for now (a hint only).

title: RecordingControls
